static_traits.name: Chen Kai
static_traits.social_status: Has a few colleagues to talk to, but hard to discuss personal feelings
static_traits.medical_history: 既往without类似心理问题;not yet接受过心理治疗或咨询;No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度高,语气坦诚;自述Anxiety但抱有希望

basic_info.main_problem: 因Divorce而认为自己not配进入亲密关系,导致Low sense of self-worth落与Loneliness感,并进一步Avoids socializing,害怕Being rejected.
basic_info.core_demands: 'Loneliness与负面自我认知已经hard to bear,影响日常生活与情绪健康,促使我寻求咨询.'并希望'摆脱这些负面想法,开始对自己感觉更好'.
growth_experiences: 两年前Divorce后开始出现并逐渐加重的'自我not配'和Loneliness感:将Divorce归因于个人失败,认为自己not够好;在Seeing happy couples或尝试社交时trigger强烈的失败与Loneliness感;为应对这些感受,倾向于Avoids socializing并将精力投入Work与爱好,但情绪仍持续;该问题影响急诊室的Work表现,人际信任与关系建立,并进一步干扰睡眠与整体身心健康;虽有少数同事可交流,但难以谈及私密感受.

core_beliefs: I am a failure(Divorce证明I am not good enough)

special_situations.event: Seeing a couple laughing in a cafe
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果离过婚,就注定without法再次拥有幸福的亲密关系
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding social situations,转而把精力放在Work与爱好上
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我再也not会有那样的幸福

special_situations.event: 尝试去认识新的人或Attending social activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人知道我Divorce,他们就会评判或拒绝我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 预先Withdrawal并避免与陌生人接触
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会因为我Divorce而看not起我

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次婚姻失败就意味着我总体上not够好,not值得被爱
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过自责与自我标签化来'Interpretation'失败,同时Reduced socializing以避免再次失败

special_situations.event: 比较他人与自己的关系状态(如Seeing happy couples)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要我have not稳定的关系,就说明我处于劣势,其他积极证据都not重要
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses on negative cues, ignores colleagues' positive feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and loved, to rebuild a stable intimate relationship
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being judged and rejected, afraid of failing and being hurt again
defense_goal: 通过保持距离与Avoids socializing来降低Being rejected的风险
Uses work and hobbies to distract attention and maintain emotional stability

object_relations.object_representation: Others/potential partners who will judge and ultimately reject oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor presses 'what evidence supports that others will evaluate you for divorcing'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为人们都会在心里看not起自己,只是not会说出来(移情:将Self-deprecationProjection为他人的评价)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用温和,支持性的探索语气;承认其感受同时Guidance具体化证据,邀请其区分'感觉'与'事实';use开放式Questioning与Clarification,适度停顿以促进自我觉察.

manifestations: Seeing happy couples时体验到强烈的失败与Loneliness
尝试社交时因害怕Being rejected而回避

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believes others will judge or reject oneself because of the divorce
即便have not直接证据也坚持'他们都这样想'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁以'我not配进入关系'限制自己
社交前过度担心Being rejected而Withdrawal

exception_events.target_problem: 在尝试与他人互动或社交时,来访者通常会Anticipation被评判并选择回避,进而加剧Loneliness感.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在Work场景中,同事知道其Divorce后仍然尊重他,have not改变对他的态度,他与同事维持Good的专业互动与关系.
exception_events.reason: not同支持与证据:同事基于其专业能力给予尊重;现实经验显示并非所有人都会因Divorce而负面评价.

positive_force: Has professional competence and gains colleagues' respect and support
Clear motivation to seek help, positive attitude, and willing to try changes (such as small social activities)
能够识do not并开始质疑负性信念(现实检验的意愿)
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and mind reading
对Being rejected与被评判的Fear导致Social avoidance
睡眠受干扰,Increased emotional burden影响功能

antecedent: Trying to socialize with new people
target_behavior.core_reason: 将Divorce视为个人失败并灾难化地推断not yet来,形成过度概括与读心术的认知,引发羞耻与Being rejected的Fear.
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的评判与拒绝,短期降低Anxiety与羞耻感.
target_behavior.consequence: 人际孤立与Loneliness感加重,Work performance affected,Declining sleep quality.
